content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for HNBGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HNBGU Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the HNBGU Guest Faculty recruitment is 06 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline to be considered for the selection process.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HNBGU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Guest Faculty positions at Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University. These vacancies are distributed across the Computer Science & Engineering and Mechanical Engineering departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email. Candidates are required to prepare their bio-data and supporting documents, then send them to the official email address provided in the university's recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the HNBGU Guest Faculty recruitment. Candidates from all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST, are exempt from paying any application charges for these positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the HNBGU Guest Faculty recruitment is based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates who submit their applications successfully will be evaluated through this interview process conducted by the university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the HNBGU Guest Faculty positions is scheduled to be held on 08 October 2026. Candidates should prepare to attend the interview at the university campus on this date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for both the Computer Science & Engineering and Mechanical Engineering Guest Faculty posts is the minimum eligibility for an Assistant Professor as per the prevailing University Grants Commission (UGC) norms.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the Guest Faculty positions at HNBGU are contractual in nature. These roles are filled to meet the temporary teaching requirements of the university departments for the specified academic session.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University campus in Srinagar-Garhwal, Uttarakhand. Specific venue details within the campus are typically mentioned in the official notification or communicated to the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for the posts if they meet the eligibility criteria for the respective departments. It is recommended to check the notification details to ensure your educational background aligns with the specific requirements of the department you are applying to.
